lines.en: Grains of soil roll under my feet.
I've crawled this road many times.
A small step, another inch.
Tiny as I am, I slip into cracks.
I am too small to make a footstep.
Soil grains packed in my leg joints.
Don't look back. Dirt is back there.
Dirt crack after dirt crack.
Eight legs, and a steady walk.
I count the pebbles underfoot.
The altar... I cannot go back.
Crawling through dirt costs me nothing.
A faint rattle in my shell.

lines.zh: 幽匿的脉动，我听得很清。
lines.en: I hear the sculk's pulse clearly.
Sun on me too long cracks my shell.
Flat on the dirt, waiting for dark.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛太干，土也救不了。
lines.en: My eyes are so dry even soil won't help.
Small as I am, I still grow sculk.

lines.zh: 我的壳晒热了，里面还凉。
lines.en: My shell warms; inside stays cold.
Something turns over in the dirt.
There's a sound in the dirt - my kin.
This little shell of mine is noisy.
Your heartbeat shakes the dirt.
Don't run - the dirt is all me.
One mite dares bite your ankle.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底沾着我的兄弟。
lines.en: My kin are stuck to your sole.
Do not turn off the light; the sculk mite fears dark.
They call me Sculk Mite. Remember.
That mass behind you is also me.

lines.zh: 你鞋缝里有泥，我能进去。
lines.en: There's mud in your boot seams. I can get in.
You stepped on me long ago.
Small as I am, I can still bite you.
Shell intact. I can still crawl.
That numbed a leg.
Click. One of my legs came off.
Back off. I warned you.
Squashed flat, and still moving.
Being crushed makes me squeak.
Don't touch - that leg's coming off.
Another stomp - I can still crawl.
I'll remember that kick.
Half of me cracked, and I still move.
With five health, I still dare to bite.
Rotten flesh smells far better than bread.
Rotten meat - the smell alone makes me hungry.
That bone - toss it here.
Even this small, I want it.
My jaw is clenched too tight.
Drop a crumb and I'll follow.
A few crumbs is all I need.
I crawl into the seams of your boots.

lines.zh: 我这么小，也只够咬一口。
lines.en: I'm small; one bite is all I have.
A bone cracked — who stepped?
Don't stomp - my shell is thin.
Small as I am, my shell is hard.
Sorry. Did I block your way?
A living person's sole is hard indeed.
Don't grind - my shell's about to break.
Knock me over; a whole brood waits in the soil.
That cost me two legs.
Are you going to pay for my legs?
You've packed the dirt solid.
Only half of me is still alive.
I saved you a dirt crack.
Even a mite remembers pain.

lines.zh: 下辈子，我们住同一个土缝。
lines.en: Next life, we'll share one dirt crack.
Share half the dirt on you with me.
We can dig our nest very deep.
All I can do is touch you with my antennae.
Closer… no, forget it.
Two mites squeezed into one dirt crack.
We swarm in a crawling mass.
Crumbs dug out of the dirt.
Hold on; I'll drag it.
This weighs more than I do; I'll drag it.
Drag it into the dirt and hide it.

lines.zh: 我小得看不见，咬得却准。
lines.en: Too small to see, but I bite true.
I recognize that pattern.
My claws are too small to pinch it.
I'll take it back to line the nest.
This stick will line the nest.
One by one, I haul them into the dirt.
I can see you through the crack.

lines.zh: 幽匿螨只有五点血，可我不怕。
lines.en: A sculk mite has five health, and I'm not afraid.
Your body heat will warm me.
That heel. Confirmed.
I'm climbing up your heel.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底，已经沾上菌了。
lines.en: There's already fungus on your soles.
Living one — halt right there.

lines.zh: 你身上那股味道，太新鲜。
lines.en: That scent on you is too fresh.
Your laces are loose - perfect.
A five-health mite takes its time.
Whoever lifts a foot first gets bitten first.
You're the only living thing in this dirt.

lines.zh: 这双眼睛，现在是幽匿的了。
lines.en: These eyes belong to the sculk now.
I've waited a long time for your feet.
Catching you is only a matter of time.
The sculk mite waits for the living to run.
It won't hurt. My teeth are tiny.

lines.zh: 一点护甲，够我咬你一口。
lines.en: One armor is enough to get a bite in.
Every step you take, I hop.
Look down - I'm at your toe.
Five drops of health, and I still give chase.

lines.zh: 土里的兄弟都在往这爬。
lines.en: My brothers in the soil are crawling this way.

lines.zh: 我从菌丝底下钻出来了。
lines.en: I've come up from under the mycelium.
The soil beneath you is moving.
Wherever you hide, the dirt follows.
The mud on your boots is my road.
A mite's appetite outgrows its body.
Slow down - fall, and I'll catch you.
Don't stomp; you can't crush all of us.
The dirt cracks are full of me.
Wait till I reach your instep.

lines.zh: 你踩过的菌毯会告诉我。
lines.en: The sculk you stepped on tells me.
Your shadow is covering me.
I never tire. Never.
Stop. Let's have a talk.
Five health. Enough to cling to you.
Stop, and I'm on your foot.
One plate of armor, harder than teeth.
Small teeth, deep cut.
My claws snagged your sleeve.
One bite and the skin breaks.
Missed. One more bite.
I crawled half a mile for this bite.
I've got your cuff.
This bite is sweet.
My teeth found an ankle.

lines.zh: 我叫你一声，幽匿都听见了。
lines.en: One cry of mine and the sculk hears.

lines.zh: 抱歉，真的抱歉，我停不下。
lines.en: Sorry, truly sorry; I cannot stop.
Just a scrape - enough.

lines.zh: 幽匿的碎屑，是我的身体。
lines.en: Sculk debris is my whole body.

lines.zh: 倒下时，别压着我的兄弟。
lines.en: When you fall, don't crush my kin.

lines.zh: 我这点力气，也够咬一口。
lines.en: Even this little strength can bite.

lines.zh: 我这口牙，专啃护甲的缝。
lines.en: These teeth are for armor seams.
I've squeezed out through a crack in the dirt.
Dark now. The dirt is cooler.
The dirt here tastes different.
This light stings my shell.
I crawled out beside the eggshells.
Someone has walked this dirt.
I am back, once again.
This tiny shell again.
I slept in the dirt. Just woke.
A sculk mite, just learning to move.
The soil under me is wet and familiar.

lines.zh: 我这样的小虫，也长了牙。
lines.en: Even a mite like me grew teeth.
I crawl out of a sculk crack.
Eyes open - first, find dirt.
Fire! My shell is crackling.
I fell, and my shell cracked.

lines.zh: 水里我沉下去，幽匿也拖我。
lines.en: In the water I sink, and the sculk drags me.

lines.zh: 这么小的我，也被炸飞了。
lines.en: Even someone this small got blown away.
A spike longer than my leg.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进我的甲缝里了。
lines.en: Magic crawled into my seams.
So hungry I'd gnaw the dirt.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的甲片都跳了。
lines.en: The lightning made my plates jump.
I'm too small for the void to catch.
